note: Anti-PD-1 antibodies entered r/r ENKTL on EBV-driven tumour PD-L1 and other-indication dosing; sintilimab gave 75% ORR, tislelizumab a modest 32%, and PD-L1 has not been shown to pick responders.
label: ENKTL (anti-PD-1)

efficacy.model: ENKTL tumour biopsies: EBV-driven PD-L1 expression (IHC)
efficacy.note: PD-L1 stained tumour cells in 79.7% of 79 ENKTL biopsies, the rationale for PD-1 blockade; no member drug tested yet.
efficacy.quote: The expression rate of PD-L1 was up to 79.7 % in ENKTL, while PD-1 expression rate was very low.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry. The only disease 'model' the class relied on in ENKTL is patient tumour tissue showing EBV-driven PD-L1 (cited as rationale by ORIENT-4 and the tislelizumab study); no animal or cell model of ENKTL was dosed with a member drug.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: objective response rate vs a qualitative prediction of susceptibility
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC8548511). Single-arm trial, no comparator. Year from NCT03228836 results posting (2020-12-17); paper online 2021-10-27.
efficacy.model: ENKTL tumour biopsies: EBV-driven PD-L1 expression (IHC)
efficacy.note: ORIENT-4: sintilimab gave 75% ORR (primary endpoint) in 28 asparaginase-failed r/r ENKTL patients, as PD-L1-driven susceptibility predicted.
efficacy.quote: Twenty-one patients (75.0%, 95% CI: 55.1-89.3%) achieved an objective response.
efficacy.judgement: Paired by me: ORIENT-4 cites PD-L1 overexpression as rationale but makes no model-vs-patient comparison. Tislelizumab's cohort 1 (ORR 31.8%, enrolment stopped for modest efficacy) is listed in patient_trials and kept as same: responses still occurred, the model predicted no magnitude, and no prespecified efficacy bar was missed.

patient_trials.quote: Modest efficacy was observed in cohort 1 (median FU, 8.4 months; ORR, 31.8%; CR, 18.2%; median DOR, not reached)

efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC10440460); the PD-L1 analysis is in a supplemental figure I did not see. Camrelizumab monotherapy trial NCT03363555 has no posted or published results.
efficacy.model: ENKTL tumour PD-L1 IHC as a responder selector
efficacy.note: In tislelizumab's ENKTL/PTCL cohorts PD-L1 expression did not track response, but too few responders had PD-L1 data to conclude.
efficacy.quote: No significant correlation was observed between PD-L1 expression and ORR
efficacy.reason: Too few PD-L1 data to judge
efficacy.judgement: Authors add that no firm conclusions can be made given the limited PD-L1 data in responders, so inconclusive rather than contra.

efficacy.model: EL4 murine T-cell lymphoma, syngeneic C57BL/6 mice, surrogate anti-mouse PD-1 (RMP1-14)
efficacy.note: Surrogate anti-PD-1 lengthened survival of EL4 lymphoma-bearing mice (median 28 vs 20 days), offered as evidence for NK/T lymphoma; no member drug tested yet.
efficacy.quote: In vivo, anti-PD1 treatment improved overall survival and median survival time of mice bearing an NK/T cell line.
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC6433108). The abstract says NK/T cell line, but the methods implant EL4, a murine T-lymphoma line, in C57BL/6 mice; the NK/T lines were used only for in-vitro PD-L1.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry at Xue's epub (2019-03-19). Kept as its own animal track because it is the only dosed in-vivo efficacy model for the class in this disease; the tumour is not an NK/T line, which lowers face validity but not admissibility.

efficacy.model: EL4 murine T-cell lymphoma, syngeneic C57BL/6 mice, surrogate anti-mouse PD-1 (RMP1-14)
efficacy.note: ORIENT-4: sintilimab gave 75% ORR (primary endpoint) in 28 r/r ENKTL patients, matching the mouse model's direction (anti-PD-1 slows lymphoma).
efficacy.quote: Twenty-one patients (75.0%, 95% CI: 55.1-89.3%) achieved an objective response.
efficacy.confidence_note: Pairing made by me; ORIENT-4 does not cite Xue 2019. Year from NCT03228836 results posting (2020-12-17, per the draft and its checker); paper online 2021-10-27. The mouse showed only modest tumour suppression, so direction only.
efficacy.reason: Patients responded as the mouse predicted
efficacy.judgement: Paired comparison (comparison_stated false). Not a retrodiction: the mouse data were public in March 2019, before any member-drug ENKTL result (ORIENT-4 interim, ASH December 2019). Tislelizumab cohort 1 (ORR 31.8%, stopped for modest efficacy) is listed in patient_trials and kept as same, as on the draft's PD-L1 track, since the model stated no magnitude.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: objective response rate vs mouse median survival gain (28 vs 20 days)

patient_trials.quote: Modest efficacy was observed in cohort 1 (median FU, 8.4 months; ORR, 31.8%; CR, 18.2%; median DOR, not reached)

safety.confidence_note: The bundled FDA multidisciplinary reviews (761232, 761380, 761417) lack OCR text for the nonclinical body, so the monkey findings were not read; all three BLAs are tislelizumab in other indications.
safety.note: Tislelizumab's 3-month monkey study is summarised in its ESCC label; no named harm compared with ENKTL patients.
safety.quote: In a 3-month repeat-dose toxicology study in cynomolgus monkeys, there were no notable effects in the male and female reproductive organs
safety.reason: Monkey study named no checkable harm
safety.judgement: Opened at the first tislelizumab label (2024); the label states no harm checkable in ENKTL trials (reproductive organs were not measured), and the ENKTL trials reported the usual immune-related events without reference to a monkey prediction.
